module.civic: Ikhaya lakho lezemiphakathi — okwenzeka manje, nokuthi yini okumele uyenze.
module.economy: Thola umsebenzi, shintshisana ngempahla nezinsizakalo, futhi ubuyekeze izivumelwano ngaphambi kokuzivuma.
module.electoral: Ukusebenza kokukhetho lapha — noma ubani ohlala endaweni angavota futhi ame ekukhethweni. Ukuvuma kukhetha iphepha lokuvota; ukuhlela ngokulandelana kugcwalisa izihlalo ngamanani alingana, ukuze kube gena kuvoti olonakele.
module.executive: Isigungu esiphethe yingxenye esenza imisebenzi — sisebenza imithetho futhi siphethe iminyango, futhi siphendula esishayamthethweni esasidala.
module.federation: Phakathi kohulumeni — ukuthi izimo zithola kanjani omunye, zihlangana, futhi zihlale ziba yizwe elilodwa.
module.judiciary: Ukusebenza kwezinkantolo — amaphanele amajaji, abameli abavulelekile kubo bonke, amajuri abahlali, nezinqumo ezirekhodi lomphakathi.
module.jurisdictions: Izindawo — yonke indawo yegunya kusukela ekhelweni kuya emhlabeni wonke: ukuthi zivuka kanjani, zihlanganiseka, zihlukane, futhi zizibuse.
module.learn: Khetha isifundo, uhambo oluholwayo, noma ividiyo. Ukufunda kuvulelekile kubo bonke.
module.legislature: Ukusebenza kokwenza umthetho — imithethosivivinywa ibunjwa ekomitini, idiscutishwe phambi kwabo bonke, futhi ivoti ngalinye libalwa ngokuhambisana nazo zonke izihlalo, ukuze ukungabikho kungalunciphisi izinga.
module.operator: Ukuphatha inodi — ama-server avontela amenza umhlaba usebenze. Ukugcina kuvulekile akuthengi ivoti noma isihlalo.
module.organizations: Izinhlangano — amaphathi, amabhizinisi, izinhlangano ezingezona zezimali, kanye neZinkampani Zenhlalakahle Yomphakathi zihlanganyela irejista eyodwa evulekile. Noma ubani, kube umuntu noma inhlangano, angasekela noma yimuphi umkhethwa.
module.rooms: Bheka imihlangano yomphakathi ngokwendawo, noma uvule igumbi lesikhungo osisebenzela kuso.
module.social: Ukusebenza kwegaba lehlelo lomphakathi — isikwele, amaqembu, nokufinyelela kubantu.
module.support: Ukuthola usizo nokubika noma yini engalungile.
module.system: Irekhodi lomphakathi elingaguquki, amawashi aqhuba umhlaba, nokuthi isimo sisekelwa kanjani.
modules.advocacy_basics.summary: Izifayela zommeli — amacala, izicelo, ubufakazi, ama-briefs — kanye namafasitela aqala khona.
modules.advocacy_basics.title: Ukusebenza egameni leklayenti
modules.bench_basics.summary: Ukukhethwa kwamajaji, ukuthi amaphanele asayizwa kanjani, nomnyango owodwa ongaphindiselwa ukuvuleka.
modules.bench_basics.title: Ibhenci: aqashwe, abe yisibalo esinganamathiso, futhi abe isinqumo sokugcina ngento eyodwa
modules.chamber_basics.summary: Okungenziwa isihlalo, okumele igumbi lonke livumelane nakho, nokuthi kungani ivoti ngalinye legumbi lingisenzo somphakathi esirekhodiwe.
modules.chamber_basics.title: Igumbi: ikhoramu, amavoti, nesihlalo sakho
modules.department_basics.summary: Ukuqashwa kweminyaka eyishumi, kanye nobude bomthetho womnyango okumele uhlale kuwo.
modules.department_basics.title: Ishumi leminyaka lelungu lebhodi
modules.executive_basics.summary: Ukuthi igunya likesigungu esiphethe livela kuphi, okubala umyalelo, nesilinganiso esiqinile sezimo eziphuthumayo.
modules.executive_basics.title: Amandla esigungu esiphethe: anikeziwe, anobude, athempala
modules.running_elections.summary: Ibhodi liqhuba imishini yokukhetho okulungile — indlela yokubala, isifunda, kanye nokuqinisekisa okubeka abanqobile ezihlalweni.
modules.running_elections.title: Ukubala ngokulungile: STV, izifunda, ukuqinisekisa
q.advocacy_basics.q1.a: F-ADV-001 — ummeli ufayila egameni leklayenti, esirekhodi
q.advocacy_basics.q1.explain: F-ADV-001 uvula icala egameni leklayenti; konke okwenziwa ummeli kuyisenzo esifayilwe nesingaqashwa kudokethi.
q.advocacy_basics.q2.explain: F-ADV-002/003/004 kuhamba nge-gate yefasitela lokunamathisela — idokethi iphelele lapho ifasitela livaleka, ukuze kube gena obambethwa ngezingathi ebhencini.
q.bench_basics.q1.c: Kumele kuqashwe — ubulungiswa baqashwa ngokuzenzakalela, iminyaka eyishumi
q.bench_basics.q1.explain: Art. IV §1: ukuqashwa kuyikona okujwayelekile, izikhathi zeminyaka eyishumi, okungenani amajaji amahlanu ngohlanga. Ukushintshela ebhodi ekhethwayo kudinga iningi elikhethekile kanye niningi elikhethekile lomvoti.
q.bench_basics.q2.a: Isibalo esinganamathala, okungenani amajaji amathathu — kuhambisana nobunzima becala
q.bench_basics.q2.c: Amalungu ayishumi nambili ejurini futhi angekho amajaji
q.bench_basics.q2.explain: Amaphanele angenamathala futhi abe okungenani amathathu (Art. IV §4), akhula ngokubona ubunzima; icala elikhulu lomthethosisekelo lithatha inkantolo yonke en banc.
q.bench_basics.q3.a: Yebo, noma nini lapho kuvela ubufakazi obusha
q.bench_basics.q3.b: Cha — ukuphindwa kokulahlwa isonto kuvimbwe esangweni lokufayila
q.bench_basics.q3.explain: Ukufayila kwesibili kunقalwa ngaphambi kokuba icala livulwe — ukuvimba kusekuqinisekiseni, hhayi ekuthandweni kwegaji.
q.chamber_basics.q1.a: Isikhombisa — iningi lalabo ababelele eseshishini sokugcina
q.chamber_basics.q1.b: Isikhombisa — iningi lalo lonke amalungu asebenza
q.chamber_basics.q1.c: Isishiyagalombili — izingxenye ezimbili ezintathu zamalungu asebenza
q.chamber_basics.q1.explain: Ikhoramu yiningi lalo lonke amalungu asebenza (Art. II §2). Izihlalo ezingenamuntu akulona amalungu asebenza, futhi ukuba khona kwangaphambilini akufakiwa ekubaleni.
q.chamber_basics.q1.prompt: Ikamala linamalungu ayishumi nambili asebenza nezihlalo ezimbili ezingenamuntu. Mangaki amalungu okumele abe khona ukuze kube nekhoramu?
q.chamber_basics.q2.a: Izingxenye ezimbili ezintathu zamalungu akhona futhi avota
q.chamber_basics.q2.b: Izingxenye ezimbili ezintathu zamalungu akhona, kanye isikhathi sekhoramu sifinyelele
q.chamber_basics.q2.c: Izingxenye ezimbili ezintathu lalo lonke amalungu asebenza — ilungu elingekho libalwa njengokuthi 'cha'
q.chamber_basics.q2.explain: Art. VII libala uhlu lonke lwamalungu asebenza, hhayi kuphela abasekamalweni. Yilokho okwenza ukuthi ukungabikho kungakwazi ukunciphisa iningi elikhethekile.
q.chamber_basics.q3.a: Ngokufayila ifomu lokuvota kwendawo (F-LEG-004) — ukuvota kwakamala konke kuyisenzo somphakathi esirekhodiwe
q.chamber_basics.q3.explain: Ukuvota kwakamala kuyizenzo zomthethosisekelo zomphakathi — F-LEG-004 irekhodi lokucwaninga. Ukufihla iphepha lokuvota kuvikela UKUKhetho; ukumela kwenziwa obala.
q.chamber_basics.q3.prompt: Ukuvota kwakho kumthethosivivinywa kwenziwa kanjani ngempela?
q.department_basics.q1.explain: Ukuqashwa kwezinto zomphakathi nobulungiswa bahlanganyela isikhathi seminyaka eyishumi (Art. II §9, Art. IV §1) futhi bahamba ndawonye — akukho okungahamba kwodwa.
q.department_basics.q1.prompt: Ukuqashwa kwelungu lebhodi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani?
q.department_basics.q2.a: Hlala ngaphakathi kobude bokusebenza obunikeziwe bomnyango
q.department_basics.q2.explain: Umnyango usebenza ngaphakathi kobude bokusebenza obunikeziwe isinqumo sokusungulwa kwaso. Ngaphandle kwalobo bude, imithetho yanqwa ngokubhekisela kulokho.
q.executive_basics.q1.c: Ukunikwa igunya isishayamthetho — ukukhethwa ngqo kuza kamuva, futhi kuphela ngeningi elikhethekile
q.executive_basics.q1.explain: Art. III: isigungu esiphethe sonke siqala ngokunikezwa igunya isishayamthetho. Ukuguqula kube ukukhethwa ngokuqondile kudinga iningi elikhethekile elimbili — lekamuphi kanye neyabavoti.
q.executive_basics.q1.prompt: Isigungu esiphethe esisha siqala kanjani ngokujwayelekile?
q.executive_basics.q2.a: Ububanzi baso buhlolwa ngokwemandla anikeziwe ehhovisi — ngaphambi kokukhipha, hhayi emva kwalokho
q.executive_basics.q2.b: Alukho lutho — imiyalelo isemthethweni ngokushesha futhi ayibuyekezwa
q.executive_basics.q2.explain: F-EXE-005 yenza ukuhlola ububanzi ngaphambi kokukhipha. Umyalelo ongaphambili kobubanzi obunikeziwe uyenqaba ngokucashunwa kwalo, hhayi ukukhipha bese kulwa emva kwesikhathi.
q.executive_basics.q2.prompt: Kumele kwenzekeni ngaphambi kokuba umyalelo wesigungu esiphethe ube nemiphumela?
q.executive_basics.q3.b: Izinsuku ezingu-90 ngesimiso noma ukuvuselelwa — futhi ukuphela kwakho kungezenzeka ngokuzenzakalela
q.executive_basics.q3.explain: Art. II §7 ibeka isilinganiso sezinsuku ezingu-90; CLK-03 iziphelisa ngokuzenzakalela. Ukuvuselelwa kwamandla asevele ephelile kuyenqaba.
q.running_elections.q1.a: STV efanele ne-Droop quota — hhayi i-first-past-the-post
q.running_elections.q1.b: Noma ubani othola amavoti amaningi uyawina
q.running_elections.q1.c: Noma yikuphi indlela ibhodi eyithandayo kulo mkhetho
q.running_elections.q1.explain: Art. II §2 ibhala i-STV ne-Droop quota. Ingakhiqizwa kuphela ngendlela efanele kakhulu — hhayi nge-plurality.
q.running_elections.q2.a: Noma yikuphi inombolo umdwebi wemephu ayithandayo
q.running_elections.q2.b: Kusuka kwinombolo eyisihlanu kuya kweyisishiyagalolunye — isishayamthetho esingaphezu kwezihlalo ezingu-9 sihlukaniseka ngezifunda
q.running_elections.q2.explain: Ibanda le-5–9 yimthetho WESIFUNDA (Art. II §2). ISIBALO esiphelele sekamuphi asinalo isilinganiso esiphezulu — Umhlaba unezihlalo ezingu-1,999 ezifundeni ezingu-282.
q.running_elections.q2.prompt: Zingaki izihlalo ezingaba nomncintiswano wesifunda esisodwa?
q.running_elections.q3.b: Ukuqinisekisa kwebhodi (F-ELB-004) — ukuhlala esihlalweni kulandela lokho ngokuzenzakalela
q.running_elections.q3.explain: Ukuqinisekisa kuwisenqumo somthethosisekelo; ukuhlala ngokuzenzakalela kulandela lokho. Isifungo (F-LEG-001) samukela ukuqinisekisa kwesihlalo esivele sekudalwe.
q.running_elections.q3.prompt: Yini eqondile ehlisa abanqobi ezihlalweni emva kokubala?

ui.check_intro: Ukuhlola okufushane kokuqonda. Ungaphinda ukuhlola unlimited — ukuhlola kufundisa, akukhethi.
ui.failed: Hhayi khona — funda izincazelo ngezansi bese uzama futhi. Ungaphinda ukuhlola unlimited.
ui.guides_intro: Izincazelo zesinyathelo ngesinyathelo zezinto abantu abazenzayo — yinye yazo imile yodwa, kanti izifundo ezigcwele ziseLearn.
ui.intro: Ukuqeqeshwa konke kuvulekele wonke umuntu — noma ngabe uphethe, noma ufuna, indima efundiswa. Izifundo zamahhala, zisendlini yohlelo, futhi zithatha imizuzu.
ui.lesson_video_demo_note: Lesi sifundo sisebenzisa irekhodi ledemo; kuvunyelwe ukuba kube nevidiyo eqondiswe esifundweni.
ui.nothing_published: Akukho okushicilelwe okwamanje — okuqukethwe kokuqeqeshwa kuzofika nomhlaba\
ui.notice: Isenzo sakho sokuqala kule ndima sizocela lokuqeqeshwa — ukuba khona akukenzi lokhu, futhi akukho lapha okuyisimo samalungelo akho.
ui.passed: Uphumelele — ukuphothula kwakho kuseirekhodini. Ungasebenza kule ndima manje.
ui.required_banner: Leso senzo sicela lokuqeqeshwa kuqala. Phumelela ekuhlolweni okufushane ngezansi, bese uzama futhi — isenzo sakho sizoqhubeka.
ui.sign_in_to_complete: Ngena ukuze uhlole futhi ubeke ukuphothula kwakho irekhodini.
